title: High-voltage testing of equipment and materials
summary: RISE runs a high-voltage laboratory that generates and measures voltages at megavolt level. Listed tests include AC and DC withstand, impulse, partial discharge and capacitance/tan delta. RISE states it has tested high-voltage cables and delivers a test report.
audience: Manufacturers and users of high-voltage equipment, cables and insulation materials
eligibility: Commercial service, open to any company
Price and lead time quoted per assignment
nextStep: Contact the RISE high-voltage unit with the voltage class, test standard and sample size to get a quote and a slot.
caveat: Capacity, price and lead time are not published and must be confirmed with RISE.

title: Marine corrosion testbeds in natural seawater
summary: Field station at Kristineberg on the Swedish west coast with atmospheric, splash and submerged exposure zones, plus a natural-seawater testbed in Brest run by the RISE subsidiary Institut de la Corrosion. Electrochemical corrosion testing in natural seawater is also offered.
audience: Companies developing materials, coatings, seals or equipment for marine and offshore environments

dates.label: Availability
dates.value: By arrangement – exposure programmes run for months to years

eligibility: Commercial service, open to any company
nextStep: Ask RISE which exposure zone and duration fit your product, and how samples should be prepared.
caveat: Exposure tests take a long time; plan validation timelines accordingly. Costs are quoted per project.

title: Accredited EMC testing of marine products
summary: Electromagnetic compatibility testing of marine products, from small components to complete systems, accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 in RISE's laboratories in Borås. Standards include EN 60945 and IACS E10.
audience: Suppliers of electronics, cabling and installations for ships and offshore units
eligibility: Commercial service, open to any company
Which standards apply depends on your product and class society
nextStep: Send RISE the product description and the marine standards you need to meet; request a test plan and quote.
caveat: A potential match only. Applicable standards depend on the product.

title: On-site EMC evaluation of installations
summary: EMC evaluations performed on site for installations that cannot be moved to a lab, including a recently added time-domain method for the 10 kHz – 30 MHz range.
audience: Operators and suppliers of large fixed installations such as power, telecom and data-centre sites
eligibility: Commercial service, open to any company
nextStep: Describe the installation and the interference problem to RISE to scope an on-site measurement.
caveat: Scope and cost depend on the site; not a grant.

title: Test and demo for SMEs 2026
summary: Grants for SMEs to test and demonstrate innovative solutions in external test and demonstration environments, to verify function, performance, safety or usability before market launch. Testing is bought from providers such as research institutes.
eligibility: SMEs only (EU definition), as the single project party
Up to SEK 1 million, max 70 % of eligible costs
Foreign entities need a branch in Sweden
nextStep: Closed. Watch Vinnova for the next round and line up a test provider (e.g. RISE) in advance.
caveat: Large companies are not eligible. A topic match does not mean a company qualifies.

title: Materials-based competitiveness 2026
summary: Funds projects that take a materials-based concept from verified lab results to a validated concept in a specific application (at least TRL 5), ready for scale-up or implementation.
audience: Companies that develop and commercialise materials-based solutions, with a concept owner and a need owner
eligibility: Up to SEK 3.5 million, up to 36 months
Coordinator must be the concept or need owner; research organisations cannot coordinate
Support rate depends on company size (25–70 %)
nextStep: Closed. Decision on 24 November 2026; watch for the 2027 round.
caveat: Eligibility depends on the project set-up and company size.

title: Digital infrastructure and communication 2026
summary: Research and innovation projects in digital infrastructure and communication. Focus areas: 5G in public and private networks, exploratory 6G research, applications, resilient digital infrastructure and satellite communication.
audience: Consortia of at least two parties, including at least one company
eligibility: SEK 2–15 million per project, max 50 % of eligible costs
Consortium of at least two, at least one industrial company
12–36 months
nextStep: Closed. Recurring programme – watch Vinnova's Advanced Digitalisation calls for the next round.

title: Acceleration of civil-military innovations 2027
organiser: Vinnova and the Swedish Armed Forces
summary: Funds Swedish companies adapting civilian technology for defence use and broadening their business to the military market, including a mandatory six-month accelerator programme.
eligibility: Swedish SMEs only, single applicant
Up to SEK 1 million + SEK 150 000 for the accelerator
Max nine months
nextStep: Closed. Decisions on 15 December 2026; watch for the next round.
caveat: SMEs only – large companies are not eligible.

title: Clean Energy Transition Partnership call 2026
summary: International research and innovation projects for the energy transition. Modules include energy-system resilience, flexibility with high renewables, hydrogen, stationary batteries and integrated industrial energy systems.
audience: Companies, universities, institutes and public bodies in international consortia
location: International (Swedish partners funded by the Swedish Energy Agency)
eligibility: Partners from at least two other countries
Swedish consortia need at least one non-research organisation
Step 2 is only for applicants invited after step 1
nextStep: Step 1 has closed. If not already in a consortium, note the themes for the 2027 call.
caveat: The Swedish Energy Agency does not fund Swedish applicants in the modules on advanced renewable power production or industrial carbon management.

title: EIC Accelerator 2027
summary: Grant and equity for start-ups and SMEs scaling breakthrough innovations. Short proposals can be submitted at any time; full proposals go to fixed cut-offs.
audience: Start-ups and SMEs with deep-tech innovations
format: Short proposal, then full proposal and interview
eligibility: Start-ups and SMEs
Highly competitive, interview stage
nextStep: Check the 2027 EIC work programme for confirmed cut-off dates.
caveat: 2027 dates come from secondary sources and differ between them.

title: Wednesday lunches with Blue Science Park
summary: Recurring lunch meetings each spring and autumn with a different theme per session, practical perspectives from experts and time to network across the Blue Science Park community.
audience: Member companies and the Blue Science Park network

dates.label: Schedule
dates.value: Spring and autumn series – check dates on the event page

eligibility: Open to the network; registration via the event page
nextStep: Check the next session's theme and register on the Blue Science Park event page.
caveat: Exact 2026/2027 dates could not be confirmed when retrieved.

title: Marine Innovation Day
summary: A day bringing together leading people from the marine technology sector across offshore energy, defence and sustainable oceans. The 2025 edition was held on 14 May.
audience: Industry, researchers and policymakers in marine technology
eligibility: Open event; registration when announced
nextStep: Follow MTC and Blue Science Park for the date of the next edition.

title: MWC Barcelona 2027
summary: The largest annual connectivity event, covering 5G/6G, network AI, devices and industry applications.
audience: Telecom operators, vendors, and companies building on connectivity
eligibility: Paid registration
nextStep: Plan meetings early. Vinnova has previously funded Swedish SME participation (the 2027 call closed in September 2026).
caveat: Ticket prices and exhibition options are set by GSMA.

title: Efficient energy use in buildings for a sustainable energy system
summary: About SEK 100 million for research and innovation projects and innovation clusters on efficient energy use in the built environment.
audience: Companies, research organisations and public actors
eligibility: Two sub-areas: R&I projects and innovation clusters
See the call text for eligible parties
nextStep: Deadline is days away – only realistic if a project is already prepared.
caveat: Deadline from search results; confirm on the Swedish Energy Agency page.
